config.motivation: First ten-variant sweep met its median criterion but had broad timing tails. A separate ABBA/BAAB confirmation reduces separation between compared calls and balances smooth time drift. No old data are discarded.
config.primary: v6_to_recurrent: sqrt(B1*B2/(A1*A2)), where A is compact v6 and B is recurrent v7
config.positive_criterion: Median primary block ratio <=0.95 in each of five sessions; all original correctness gates and exact normalized decode must pass.
config.secondary: hoisted_to_recurrent and original_to_recurrent remain descriptive; no substitute primary. Report all block ratios, tails and fractions, without claiming independence of blocks or hardware-counter attribution.
config.scope: Same immutable v7 shader, inputs, memory and represented values. Only host timing order changes. No inference/runtime or model-quality claim. ABBA cancels ideal linear log-time drift, not arbitrary interference.
